summary.text: Will Johanson is the Libertarian Party nominee for Idaho's 2nd Congressional District. According to his campaign website, he grew up in California's Central Valley, served in the U.S. Navy as a nuclear operator, and now works as an engineer in Idaho's semiconductor industry. He advanced from the Libertarian primary on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, was born and raised in California's Central Valley and says his interest in liberty began during Ron Paul's 2008 presidential campaign.
Enlisted in the U.S. Navy as a nuclear operator and served aboard the USS Georgia as an Engineering Laboratory Technician; he separated in 2020 as a Machinist's Mate (Nuclear) First Class (E-6).
Used the GI Bill to earn bachelor's and master's degrees in Materials Science & Engineering from Boise State University, according to his campaign website.
Works as an engineer in Idaho's semiconductor industry; his campaign is headquartered in Boise.
